values: 战斗开始时展开推演，推演结束后收集线索曝光犯人，主动释放时揭露敌人弱点施加负面效果。
Sherlock Holmes runs a simulation when a battle starts, then gathers clues to expose Suspects. When actively used, this skill weakens enemies by exposing their vulnerabilities.

战斗开始前在自身对称位置召唤继承自身150%属性的“投影”，对“投影”及其周围1格范围内的敌人展开最多持续8秒的推演，该过程不计入战斗时间。推演完成后“投影”消失，并认定其中攻击“投影”的敌人作为“罪犯”，对“投影”造成最高伤害的“罪犯”视为“主犯”。
在挑战首领的模式中，若该范围内只有1名敌人，则跳过推演过程直接认定该敌人为“主犯”。
被动地，自身会在战斗中每秒收集“罪犯”的3点线索，收集100点线索后会使“罪犯”被彻底曝光，使其能量获取效率降低60%并且降低24% + 3%基础属性。此外，收集“主犯”以及处于控制状态的“罪犯”的线索时，每秒额外收集2点，同时处于这两种状态时额外收集量会叠加。
主动释放时，推理揭露敌人弱点，使所有敌人在接下来10秒内造成伤害降低15% + 1.5%，受到伤害提高12% + 1%，“罪犯”受到该效果的影响额外提高100%。

Before battle, Sherlock Holmes summons a projection at his mirrored position that inherits 150% of his stats. He then simulates combat between the projection and enemies within 1 tile of it for up to 8s. This simulation does not count toward the battle duration. When it ends, the projection disappears, and enemies who attacked it are marked as Suspects. The Suspect who dealt the most damage to the projection is designated as the Culprit.
In boss fights, if there is only one enemy in range, Sherlock Holmes skips the simulation and designates that enemy as the Culprit.
Passive. Sherlock Holmes gathers 3 clues on each Suspect every second during battle. Once he has gathered 100 clues on a Suspect, he exposes them, reducing their Energy recovery efficiency by 60% and their basic stats by 24% + 3%. He gathers 2 extra clues each second on the Culprit and on Suspects affected by control effects. If the Culprit is also under a control effect, the extra clue gains stack.
Active. Sherlock Holmes exposes all enemies' weaknesses for 10s, reducing their damage dealt by 15% + 1.5% and increasing their damage taken by 12% + 1%. These effects are 100% stronger against Suspects.
“罪犯”被彻底曝光后降低的基础属性提高至26% + 3%基础属性。
Increases the basic stat reduction inflicted on fully exposed Suspects to 26% + 3%.
“罪犯”被彻底曝光后降低的基础属性提高至28% + 3%基础属性。
Increases the basic stat reduction inflicted on fully exposed Suspects to 28% + 3%.
“罪犯”被彻底曝光后降低的基础属性提高至30% + 3%基础属性。
Increases the basic stat reduction inflicted on fully exposed Suspects to 30% + 3%.
“罪犯”被彻底曝光后降低的基础属性提高至32% + 3%基础属性。
Increases the basic stat reduction inflicted on fully exposed Suspects to 32% + 3%.
投掷烟斗造成范围伤害，并致盲其中的犯人。
Sherlock Holmes throws his pipe to deal AoE damage, blinding the Suspects in range.

被动地，推演选定的范围视为“犯罪现场”，收集位于“犯罪现场”的“罪犯”线索时，每秒还会再额外收集3点。
主动释放时，在指定位置投掷烟斗干扰敌人，对其周围1格范围内的敌人造成240% + 30% ATK伤害并使目标在接下来8秒内降低30% + 3%攻击力，若该目标为“罪犯”，额外使其致盲8秒。该技能优先对“罪犯”最密集的区域释放。

Passive. The simulation area becomes the Crime Scene. Sherlock Holmes gathers 3 extra clues each second on Suspects within this area.
Active. Sherlock Holmes throws his pipe at a chosen location, dealing 240% + 30% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile. For the next 8s, their ATK is reduced by 30% + 3%. Suspects hit are also blinded for 8s. This skill prioritizes the area with the most Suspects.
Increases the damage dealt to 260% + 30% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 280% + 30% ATK.
Increases the damage dealt to 300% + 30% ATK.
为最靠前和最虚弱的友军分别添加护盾。
Sherlock Holmes grants a shield to both the frontmost ally and the weakest ally.
驱动机械装置提前布置反制手段，为最靠前和最虚弱的友军添加380% + 40% ATK的护盾持续10秒，护盾存在期间受到来自“罪犯”的伤害降低30% + 3%。

Sherlock Holmes deploys mechanical devices to set up defensive countermeasures, granting the frontmost ally and the weakest ally shields equal to 380% + 40% ATK. Each shield lasts 10s. While shielded, these allies take 30% + 3% less damage from Suspects.
Increases the shield value to 400% + 40% ATK.
Increases the shield value to 420% + 40% ATK.
Increases the shield value to 440% + 40% ATK.
提高自身急速，有犯人被曝光或击败后额外提高。
Sherlock Holmes increases his Haste, with a further increase when a Suspect is exposed or defeated.
自身提高9点急速，有“罪犯”被曝光或被击败后额外提高6点。
Sherlock Holmes gains 9 Haste and an extra 6 Haste when a Suspect is exposed or defeated.
自身提高12点急速，有“罪犯”被曝光或被击败后额外提高8点。
Sherlock Holmes gains 12 Haste and an extra 8 Haste when a Suspect is exposed or defeated.
自身提高15点急速，有“罪犯”被曝光或被击败后额外提高10点。
Sherlock Holmes gains 15 Haste and an extra 10 Haste when a Suspect is exposed or defeated.
用投影代替自身战斗，自身退居幕后更快地收集线索。
Sherlock Holmes sends a projection into battle in his place and gathers clues faster from behind the scenes.
“推演”结束后，用继承自身100%属性且具有额外200点初始能量的“投影”代替自身进入战斗，自身则退至幕后，进入无敌状态直到“投影”被击败。退居幕后期间，自身收集线索的效率提高150%。

After the simulation, Sherlock Holmes sends a projection into battle in his place. It inherits 100% of his stats and gains 200 extra initial Energy. Holmes stays behind the scenes, remaining invincible until the projection is defeated. While behind the scenes, he gathers clues 150% more efficiently.
Increases the projection's initial Energy to 300.
当“罪犯”被曝光后，将受到社会更严厉的排斥：受到来自他人的治疗或护盾降低99%，且受到的生命损耗提高10%。
Exposed Suspects face harsher treatment: they receive 99% less healing and shielding from others and suffer 10% more HP loss.
Increases the projection's initial Energy to 400.
推演结束后根据敌人的战斗过程施加不同的控制效果。
After the simulation, Sherlock Holmes applies different control effects to Suspects based on their actions during it.
推演结束后，若“罪犯”在推演期间释放过终极技能，使其沉默持续7秒，否则使其缴械持续7秒。若“罪犯”为首领敌人，则使其受到生命损耗提高22.1%持续13秒。
After the simulation, Suspects who cast their Ultimate during it are silenced for 7s. Those who didn't are disarmed for 7s. If a Suspect is a boss, it suffers 22.1% more HP loss for 13s.
